newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Colombian peso dips 1.7 pesos in busy session.
newsitem.headline: Colombian peso dips 1.7 pesos in busy session.

text.p: Colombia's peso lost 1.7 pesos to close at 1,075.5 against the dollar in a busy session dominated by financial sector demand for greenbacks.
"There's still no real trend and the recent cut in interest rates really has had only a marginal effect," one dealer said.
The central bank cut one percentage point off its overnight, 30-day and 90-day interest rates on May 7. Since then the peso has lost a lower-than-expected 7 pesos against the dollar.
Dealers reported 600 trades worth a total $222 million, above the daily average of about $180 million. Interbank dealers were unable to provide details on minimum and maximum intraday rates.
